entries.name: Flutter 3.44.9 iOS AOT
entries.evidence: Nofpad Windows lab: Dart kernel, assets, AOT, native assets and IPA completed.
entries.notes: Use the Flutter release that contains the matching iOS gen_snapshot; do not silently fall back to the system Flutter.

entries.name: Flutter Linux host path
entries.evidence: Linux host integration matrix in CI.
entries.notes: A Darwin SDK cache is required for the host/target combination.

entries.name: audio_waveforms
entries.evidence: Nofpad lab override under packages/ios_spm_overrides; target compiled with --jobs 1.
entries.notes: The override imports Flutter in native Swift files. Recheck when changing plugin versions.

entries.name: permission_handler_apple
entries.evidence: Nofpad lab override; Objective-C public header and implementation imports were made explicit.
entries.notes: Provisioning and entitlement behavior still belongs to the consuming app.

entries.name: cloud_firestore
entries.evidence: Nofpad lab override; FirebaseFirestoreInternal was imported before FirebaseFirestore in affected Objective-C files.
entries.notes: This is compile evidence, not a claim that every Firebase feature works on a device.

entries.name: Embedded Widget extension
entries.evidence: Nofpad App Store build carried and signed nofpadWidgets.appex with its own profile.
entries.notes: The host and extension must use matching Team ID, Bundle ID, App Group and entitlements.

entries.name: MLKit and native binary frameworks
entries.evidence: Nofpad build was accepted after a linker workaround that excluded MLKit frameworks and used dynamic lookup.
entries.notes: Apple acceptance does not prove runtime symbol availability. Test camera, OCR and text recognition on a real iPhone before release.
